iceland.title: Flag of Iceland

colors.note: Represents the Atlantic Ocean surrounding Iceland and the mountains on clear days.
Symbolises the glaciers, snow, and ice that cover much of the island.
Evokes the volcanic fire and lava that created the island.

desc:
- A blue field with an off-centre red Nordic cross outlined in white, the red cross itself bordered in white
- The cross arm extends to the right, aligning Iceland with other Nordic countries' cross-based flags
- First hoisted in 1915, adopted as a civil flag in 1918, and confirmed as the national flag on 17 June 1944 when Iceland became a republic
trivia:
- The colours together evoke Iceland's landscape: blue seas, white glaciers, red volcanoes
- The horizontal cross arm is set closer to the hoist, a shared convention of all Nordic flags
- The flag's proportions were fixed by law in 1944 at 18:25, unusual among national flags
